title: Order the server build
intro: From empty folder to inspected server — the course's exact path. Put it in order.
prompt: Drag into build order, first step on top.

steps.text: uv init the project, create and activate the venv
uv add mcp arxiv — add the dependencies
Move the functions in and decorate them with @mcp.tool()
npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector — connect, list tools, call them

debrief: Environment first (uv init + deps), then the FastMCP declaration, then the functions-become-tools step, then the transport line, and only then the inspector. The two steps people swap: the transport line must exist before anything can connect — and inspection comes before any client is written, because interactive list/call against the bare server is the cheapest debugging you'll ever do.
